summary: Corner Growth Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC/blank-check company) filed an 8-K disclosing that its board determined it cannot complete a business combination by the deadline and will liquidate/dissolve under Cayman Islands law. The company will redeem all public shares for cash equal to the trust account balance (including interest, less up to $100,000 for expenses and net of taxes). No deal price, premium, or advisors are named. The move extinguishes public shareholder rights. This is a standard SPAC liquidation, with the trust to be distributed as soon as practicable. Watch for the per-share redemption amount and timetable.
